scope: Input constants and fixture mechanics only; no observed outputs, expected results, retry budgets, classifications or oracle data.

factory_missing_key.mechanism: Actual compatible provider resolves a null stored credential; the missing-key exception is produced by production code, not injected by the fixture.

call_mechanics: If input visible is true, yield one TextDelta with text synthetic visible output.
Throw the exception instance constructed for the selected failure label.
script_provider.cancellation_mechanics: The script deliberately does not check the caller token. The actual retry provider receives that token and decides admission. No fixture cancellation exception is added.
script_provider.session_mechanics: Use the production ILLMProvider default stateless session over the script Call.

factory_provider.other_options: Actual source OpenAICompatibleOptions defaults; no additional fixture overrides.

get_mechanics: Check the supplied cancellation token with ThrowIfCancellationRequested.
For factory_auth, throw a new AuthException with message synthetic auth failure.
store.set_delete_mechanics: Throw NotSupportedException without an explicit message; these operations are not invoked by this fixture.

send_mechanics: Return a new HttpResponseMessage with status OK (200).

transparent_counting_wrapper.physical_calls: Increment before delegating each provider Call or session Call to the actual inner provider/session. This counts provider attempts, including attempts that fail before any HTTP send.
transparent_counting_wrapper.enumerator_disposals: Increment in a finally surrounding await-foreach enumeration of each delegated stream. The wrapper forwards the supplied cancellation token via WithCancellation and does not independently throw or classify.
transparent_counting_wrapper.session_disposals: Increment before awaiting the delegated session DisposeAsync.
transparent_counting_wrapper.fallback: Delegate TryFallBackToHttp to the inner session.

explicit_overrides: TimeProvider is the immediate fixture below.
retry_wrapper.other_settings: Unmodified production defaults; budgets, delays, event contents and failure policy are not fixture inputs.

create_timer_mechanics: Record the actual dueTime.TotalMilliseconds supplied by production as a signed integer.
Invoke the provided callback immediately when dueTime is not Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan.

per_case_observer.cancellation: Create a fresh CancellationTokenSource; cancel it before starting the call exactly when input caller_cancelled is true.
per_case_observer.direct_mode: Enumerate actual retry provider Call with the request and caller token, capturing yielded events and the terminal exception.
per_case_observer.session_mode: Open actual retry session; BeginTurn; enumerate its Call with the same request/token; await session disposal before projecting counters.
per_case_observer.event_projection: Actual Kind.ToString, Text, Attempt and RetryAfter.TotalMilliseconds only.
per_case_observer.error_projection: Actual terminal CLR FullName and unmodified Message.
per_case_observer.diagnostic_probe: Call actual DiagnosticEvent.ClassifyFailure on the constructed exception for the input failure category. This is separate from physical request tracing and does not invent classification values.
